roles.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
roles.description: I design risk-based test scenarios for online banking applications covering account management, fund transfers and loan servicing. I also coordinate defect triage and release testing within a Scrum team.
highlights: Automated prioritized regression scenarios with Selenium WebDriver, Python, PyTest and the Page Object Model in Azure DevOps pipelines, achieving approximately 35% automation coverage.
Executed end-to-end testing across web applications and backend services, contributing to an estimated 20% reduction in recurring defects through improved regression coverage.
Evaluated AI-assisted test case generation against business requirements and edge cases, reducing initial test scenario drafting effort by an estimated 25% where applicable.
Performance-tested key account and fund transfer REST APIs with Apache JMeter load and stress tests at expected peak volumes, reporting response-time, throughput and error-rate bottlenecks.
Validated REST APIs with Postman and SQL queries against account data and transaction postings, investigating data-mapping discrepancies between integrated components.

roles.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
roles.description: Tested digital payment journeys involving UPI transactions, wallet operations and payment status updates across functional, integration and regression cycles.
highlights: Automated repeatable web application test cases with Selenium WebDriver, Python and PyTest, increasing automation coverage of selected payment regression scenarios by approximately 30%.
Managed defects in Jira with reproduction steps, expected and actual results, severity and evidence, contributing to an estimated 20% reduction in defect clarification cycles.
Investigated failed payment scenarios by reproducing defects, reviewing logs and tracing transaction behavior across dependent services to help developers isolate root causes.
Verified REST API responses with Postman and SQL queries, comparing transaction records with expected results to investigate discrepancies with backend data.
Validated negative payment scenarios, including invalid inputs, interrupted transactions and error responses, to find inconsistencies affecting the customer payment experience.

roles.title: Software Test Engineer
roles.description: Prepared test cases from functional specifications for web-based applications and performed manual functional and regression testing after application changes.
highlights: Executed approximately 100 test cases per release cycle across assigned modules, maintaining execution results and defect records.
Checked form submissions, input boundaries and session behavior across supported browsers, identifying compatibility and validation issues.
Supported API and database validation with Postman and basic SQL queries, checking service responses and persisted data beyond the user interface.
Retested resolved defects and performed targeted regression checks to catch unintended changes before release.
